body: Founder: dragonsnshit dead, no respawn, home point crystal like wow -> use arena fountain model, nicer. Shipped: dead g_target_hp==0 worms no longer render/retarget; KO auto-respawn wires the MUD's existing home/sethome commands to auto-fire client-side the moment a real status-line parse reports hp==0; new 3-tier pulsing Home Point Crystal in Town (arena-fountain-derived) whose right-click sends real sethome. Live-verified end-to-end under Xvfb against a real disposable test character: real combat brought HP to 0/90, client polled hp=0 three real ticks, auto home fired, character respawned at HP 1/90 with real XP loss -- a genuine server-side respawn, not a display artifact. sethome curl-confirmed (Home Point registered at Meadow). Crystal visually screenshot-confirmed. All temp test instrumentation and the disposable character removed before commit. Commits 93aabdc, eaab1bf.
title: Dead worms disappear, KO auto-respawn, Home Point Crystal
